name: Brightening Glow Kit by The Health Healer | Face Wash, Scrub & Night Cream Set
description:
The Brightening Glow Kit by The Health Healer is a complete skincare set designed to cleanse, brighten, and nourish your skin. Featuring a deep-cleansing face wash, gentle exfoliating scrub, and rejuvenating night cream, this kit is suitable for all skin types. With consistent use, it helps remove impurities, enhance radiance, and reduce signs of aging, leaving your skin smooth, refreshed, and glowing day and night.

Key Features
Complete 3-step skincare routine: face wash, scrub, and night cream
Cleanses impurities and brightens complexion
Exfoliates dead skin cells and removes blackheads
Rejuvenates and hydrates skin overnight
Reduces dark spots, fine lines, and signs of aging
Suitable for all skin types, gentle and nourishing

How to Use
Face Wash: Apply on moist skin, massage gently, rinse, and pat dry
Scrub: Massage on damp skin in circular motion for 5 minutes, rinse with warm water
Night Cream: Apply a pea-sized amount at night, massage until absorbed
Use daily for best results

Material
Natural extracts, vitamins (E & B3), jojoba oil, paraben-free formulation

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Keep out of reach of children
Discontinue use if irritation occurs

Package Includes
1 × Health Healer Face Wash
1 × Health Healer Scrub
1 × Health Healer Night Cream
